types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AffiliateShare
types.doc:
AffiliateShare credits one affiliate vault, a sub-account the broker owns,
 with a fee charged on top of the service and broker fees.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of an active affiliate vault of the broker
 (QuickSwapBrokerService.CreateAffiliateVault). Create the vault first: an
 unknown, disabled or other broker's vault, or the default vault, fails
 with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN.

fields.name: bps
fields.doc: Fee in basis points of what each leg receives, from 1 to 300.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AffiliateVault
types.doc:
AffiliateVault is a sub-account of the broker root, owned by the broker,
 credited with the fees of one affiliate. Affiliate vaults are never
 deleted.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Public sub-account ID of the vault; name it in AffiliateShare.account_id.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Broker-chosen label, unique per broker.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Whether new QuickSwaps can name the vault.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the vault was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the vault was last changed.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AssetVolume
types.doc: AssetVolume is a total amount in one asset.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Total, in base units of 18 decimals.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Broker
types.doc: Broker is a broker org.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Broker name: the immutable identifier used in every request.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc: Display name.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc:
Whether the broker may quote and create QuickSwaps. A disabled broker
 keeps reads, vaults, keys and members.

fields.name: root_account_id
fields.doc: Public account ID of the broker's root account.

fields.name: default_vault_account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the default vault, credited with broker fees
 that name no affiliate.

fields.name: max_affiliate_vaults
fields.doc:
Affiliate vaults the broker may create, active and disabled together.
 At the limit, CreateAffiliateVault fails with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED /
 BROKER_LIMIT.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: The caller's role; BROKER_ROLE_UNSPECIFIED for a broker API key.

fields.name: quote_rps
fields.doc:
Quote requests per second allowed for each API key of the broker, which
 is also the burst. Over the rate, QuoteQuickSwap fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT and a Retry-After header.

fields.name: create_rps
fields.doc:
Create requests per second allowed for each API key of the broker, which
 is also the burst. Over the rate, CreateQuickSwap fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT and a Retry-After header.

fields.name: read_rps
fields.doc:
Read requests per second allowed for each API key of the broker, which is
 also the burst. GetQuickSwap and every QuickSwapBrokerService call by an
 API key count as reads. Over the rate, the call fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT and a Retry-After header.

fields.name: max_unfunded_addresses
fields.doc:
Unfunded Quick Swaps the broker may hold at once: Quick Swaps whose
 deposit address is being issued or is still awaiting a deposit within
 its funding window. At the limit, CreateQuickSwap fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT; a deposit or the end of a funding
 window frees a slot.

fields.name: max_creates_per_hour
fields.doc:
Quick Swaps the broker may create in any rolling hour. At the limit,
 CreateQuickSwap fails with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT until the
 oldest create of the hour is more than an hour old.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerKey
types.doc: BrokerKey is a broker API key, without its secret.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: Public key ID: the part of the token between "qsk_" and the second "_".

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Label given at creation; empty for a key created by rotation.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the key was created.

fields.name: created_by_account_id
fields.doc:
Public account ID of the member who created the key; 0 for a key that a
 key created by rotating itself.

fields.name: rotated_from
fields.doc: Key this key replaced by rotation; empty otherwise.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
End of the key's rotation overlap; the key stops working then. Unset
 while the key works until revoked.

fields.name: revoked_at
fields.doc: When the key was revoked; unset while not revoked.

fields.name: active
fields.doc: Whether the key works now: neither revoked nor past expires_at.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerRole
types.doc:
BrokerRole is a person's role in a broker org. A broker has exactly one
 Owner.

values.name: OWNER
values.doc: Everything, including transferring ownership. Exactly one per broker.

values.name: ADMIN
values.doc: Everything except changing the Owner or transferring ownership.

values.name: FINANCE
values.doc: Internal transfers, withdrawals and payout settings.

values.name: AFFILIATE_MANAGER
values.doc: Creates affiliate vaults and views balances.

values.name: VIEWER
values.doc: Read-only.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerStatsPeriod
types.doc:
BrokerStatsPeriod is a broker's QuickSwap activity in one UTC day or
 month. A QuickSwap counts in the period it was created in, with its
 current status, its credited deposit and its destination payout, so a
 period's numbers keep moving until its QuickSwaps end. A fee counts in the
 period it was charged in, as in GetFeeTotals, which can be later than the
 period its QuickSwap was created in.

fields.name: period_start
fields.doc: Start of the UTC day or month.

fields.name: created_count
fields.doc: QuickSwaps created in the period, inside the window.

fields.name: statuses
fields.doc:
Those QuickSwaps by current status, in QuickSwapStatus number order;
 statuses with none are omitted. The counts total created_count.

fields.name: deposited
fields.doc:
Deposits credited to those QuickSwaps and taken in for execution, per
 asset, in asset_id order: including a deposit later found ineligible
 and returned, excluding a deposit held for review before credit.

fields.name: delivered
fields.doc:
Paid to the destination of those QuickSwaps whose DESTINATION
 withdrawal is FINALIZED, per asset, in asset_id order: after service,
 broker and affiliate fees, before the destination network fee.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc:
Fees charged to the broker's QuickSwaps in the period, per asset, in
 asset_id order. broker_fee plus affiliate_fee equals the GetFeeTotals
 total of the same window, period and asset.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerUsage
types.doc:
BrokerUsage is the broker's current use of its limits, counted exactly as
 the limits are enforced: the next create is refused while a count is at or
 above its limit on Broker. A count can be above its limit after the limit
 is lowered. The counts are read when the request is served and can change
 right after with concurrent creates, deposits and expiring funding windows.

fields.name: unfunded_addresses
fields.doc:
Unfunded Quick Swaps held now, counted against
 Broker.max_unfunded_addresses.

fields.name: creates_last_hour
fields.doc:
Quick Swaps created in the last hour, counted against
 Broker.max_creates_per_hour.

fields.name: affiliate_vaults
fields.doc:
Affiliate vaults created, active and disabled together, counted against
 Broker.max_affiliate_vaults.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ChargedFee
types.doc:
ChargedFee is what one vault has been credited with for a QuickSwap in
 one asset, from settled fills and bridge payouts.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: BROKER or AFFILIATE.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the credited vault: the default vault for
 BROKER, the affiliate vault for AFFILIATE.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset credited, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Amount credited, in base units of 18 decimals.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateAffiliateVaultRequest
types.doc:
CreateAffiliateVaultRequest creates, or returns, the affiliate vault with a
 label.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name. A broker API key may name only its own broker.

fields.name: label
fields.doc:
Label, 1 to 64 characters without leading or trailing whitespace, unique
 per broker. The same label always returns the same vault.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateAffiliateVaultResponse
types.doc: CreateAffiliateVaultResponse returns the vault.

fields.name: vault
fields.doc: The vault.

fields.name: created
fields.doc: Whether this request created it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateKeyRequest
types.doc: CreateKeyRequest creates a broker API key.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Label, 1 to 64 characters without leading or trailing whitespace.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateKeyResponse
types.doc:
CreateKeyResponse returns the key and its token. The token is shown only
 here and cannot be recovered.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The key.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Bearer token qsk_<key id>_<secret>. Store it as a server secret.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateQuickSwapRequest
types.doc:
CreateQuickSwapRequest creates, or returns, the QuickSwap for one
 idempotency key.

cel.message: refund_zipped_asset_id and refund_address must be set together, and refund_memo requires refund_address

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Broker-chosen idempotency key, 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits,
 '.', '_', ':' or '-'. Scoped to the authenticated broker and retained
 permanently. The same key with the same request returns the same QuickSwap
 and deposit address; with a different request it fails with
 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Requests are compared after every valid address and
 memo is put in its network's canonical form, so the same address in
 another case or encoding is the same request; affiliate order is
 ignored; every other field, the fees included, must be equal.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Economic terms.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of the swap output on the destination network, in its native
 text form without memo.

fields.name: destination_memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo for destination_address. Required when the
 destination network needs one; must be empty otherwise.

fields.name: return_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of returned source funds on the source network, in its native
 text form without memo. Deposits that are not accepted, and source funds
 that are not traded, go here; never to an observed sender.

fields.name: return_memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo for return_address. Required when the source
 network needs one; must be empty otherwise.

fields.name: refund_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Refund route for the intermediate asset of a two-leg route: an
 AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id of the asset whose AssetConfig.ledger_id
 is the quote's intermediate_asset_id in GET
 /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config, for example USDT on Ethereum. Required
 with refund_address when the route has an intermediate asset; optional
 and unused otherwise.

fields.name: refund_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of refunded intermediate asset on the refund route's network,
 in its native text form without memo.

fields.name: refund_memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo for refund_address. Required when the refund
 network needs one; must be empty otherwise.

fields.name: source_wallet
fields.doc:
Optional source wallet the end user will deposit from, for brokers that
 know it in advance. It must be a valid address on the source network and
 is shown on the QuickSwap.

fields.name: affiliates
fields.doc:
Affiliate fees, each charged on top and credited to its affiliate vault:
 at most three distinct vaults. Fixed at creation with broker_bps.

fields.name: broker_bps
fields.doc:
Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of
 the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none.
 broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300. Fees outside these
 rules fail with FEES_INVALID.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateQuickSwapResponse
types.doc: CreateQuickSwapResponse returns the QuickSwap bound to the idempotency key.

fields.name: quick_swap
fields.doc:
The QuickSwap, normally AWAITING_DEPOSIT with deposit_instructions. A
 retry returns its current state with the original quote and address.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Deposit
types.doc: Deposit is one deposit detected on the QuickSwap's deposit address.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: Zero-based position in detection order; stable for the QuickSwap's life.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc: Source-network transaction identifier in the network's native text form.

fields.name: tx_occurrence_index
fields.doc: Output or log index of the deposit within tx_hash; zero is valid.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset and network actually received, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero until
 Polyester has identified the deposit's asset, shortly after detection,
 and when the asset is not a supported route.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Received amount, before the deposit network fee, in zipped_asset_id's
 token units; unset while zipped_asset_id is zero.

fields.name: disposition
fields.doc: What this deposit may do.

fields.name: reason
confirmations
fields.doc:
Current source-network confirmations; zero until the source network
 reports any. Never decreases.

fields.name: required_confirmations
fields.doc: Source-network confirmations required before credit; zero until known.

fields.name: detected_at
fields.doc:
When the deposit was first seen. Eligibility compares this time with
 funding_expires_at.

fields.name: credited_at
fields.doc:
When the deposit was credited; unset until credited. Credit does not
 decide eligibility: a credited deposit can still be EVALUATING, and one
 then found ineligible, such as a late deposit, stays credited and is
 returned (RETURN_ONLY).

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc:
Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this deposit, usable with
 GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. Lifecycle flow
 amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositAddressState
types.doc: DepositAddressState is the lifecycle state of a QuickSwap deposit address.

values.name: ACTIVE
values.doc: The address accepts the first eligible deposit.

values.name: REFUND_MODE
values.doc:
Entered on the first confirmed deposit. Any further deposit is returned
 or held and never executes. Ends at address_retires_at. An address that
 expires unfunded goes from ACTIVE straight to RETIRED.

values.name: RETIRED
values.doc:
The address is retired. A deposit sent to it is not processed
 automatically; it is handled only through support-assisted recovery, and
 recovery is not guaranteed.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositDisposition
types.doc: DepositDisposition is what a detected deposit is allowed to do.

values.name: EVALUATING
values.doc:
Detected; eligibility is being evaluated. A deposit can already be
 credited (credited_at) while it is evaluated.

values.name: ELIGIBLE
values.doc:
The eligible deposit that confirmed first. It consumed the QuickSwap and
 is the only deposit that can execute.

values.name: RETURN_ONLY
values.doc:
Not accepted: it is returned to return_address and never executes. A
 deposit found ineligible after it was credited, such as a late deposit
 (LATE_DEPOSIT), one below min_deposit_amount (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) or
 above max_deposit_amount (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM), or one of the wrong
 asset or network (WRONG_ASSET), keeps credited_at and is returned from its
 credit.

values.name: ON_HOLD
values.doc: Held for review; it neither executes nor returns until released.

values.name: MANUAL_RECOVERY
values.doc:
Arrived after address_retires_at. It is handled only through
 support-assisted recovery; recovery is not guaranteed. The broker
 contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositInstructions
types.doc: DepositInstructions tell the end user where and until when to deposit.

fields.name: address
fields.doc: Deposit address in the source network's native text form, without memo.

fields.name: memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo the deposit must carry; empty when the source
 network uses none. A deposit without it cannot be attributed.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset and network to deposit; equal to terms.source_zipped_asset_id.

fields.name: issued_at
fields.doc:
When the address was issued to this QuickSwap; the funding window starts
 here. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE it can be long after created_at.

fields.name: funding_expires_at
fields.doc:
End of the funding window, fixed when the address is issued (currently 7
 days after issued_at). A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it
 before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and
 confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time,
 even one broadcast earlier, is returned to return_address. Send deposits
 well before this time. Never changes.

fields.name: address_retires_at
fields.doc:
After this time the deposit address is retired and funds sent to it may
 not be recoverable. For an unfunded address it equals funding_expires_at.
 After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until
 Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the
 QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all
 payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before
 funding_expires_at.

fields.name: address_state
fields.doc: Current lifecycle state of the address.

fields.name: min_native_gas_limit
fields.doc:
A native-coin deposit (for example ETH) needs at least this gas limit, in
 gas units; a plain 21000-gas transfer is not enough and fails without
 depositing. Unused gas is refunded, so a higher limit is safe. Zero for
 token deposits and non-EVM networks.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc: ErrorCode is the stable machine-readable QuickSwap error code.

values.name: ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc:
The source and destination route is not offered, or a bridge was
 requested with TWAP execution.

values.name: AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE
values.doc:
The amount is outside the route's current limits. The error carries the
 limits (min_deposit_amount, max_deposit_amount) when known.

values.name: DECIMALS_MISMATCH
values.doc: An amount's decimals do not match its route's token decimals.

values.name: DESTINATION_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc:
destination_address or destination_memo is not valid on the destination
 network.

values.name: RETURN_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc: return_address or return_memo is not valid on the source network.

values.name: REFUND_ADDRESS_REQUIRED
values.doc: The route has an intermediate asset and no refund address was supplied.

values.name: REFUND_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc:
refund_zipped_asset_id is not a withdraw route of the intermediate asset,
 or refund_address or refund_memo is not valid on its network.

values.name: SOURCE_WALLET_INVALID
values.doc: source_wallet is not valid on the source network.

values.name: QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: No price is currently available for the route; retry later.

values.name: PROTECTION_UNACHIEVABLE
values.doc:
The protection cannot be met at the current price: a min_amount_out above
 the expected output, or an order book that cannot fill the protected
 execution at the quoted prices.

values.name: ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
No deposit address is available right now. The QuickSwap (swap_id in the
 error) is kept, and its address is allocated automatically when one frees
 up. Follow it with GetQuickSwap or by repeating the request unchanged. Its
 quote stays the one priced at creation, and its funding window starts
 when the address is issued (issued_at).

values.name: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc: The idempotency key was already used with a different request.

values.name: SWAP_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No QuickSwap of this broker matches the selector.

values.name: BROKER_DISABLED
values.doc:
The broker is disabled: quotes and creates are refused. Reads and
 QuickSwaps already created continue.

values.name: BROKER_LIMIT
values.doc:
A broker limit was reached: the unfunded QuickSwaps held at once, the
 QuickSwaps created per hour, the request rate of the API key, or the
 affiliate vaults the broker may create. Nothing is bound to the key. A
 funded or expired QuickSwap frees an unfunded slot; when the response
 carries a Retry-After header, retry after that many seconds.

values.name: AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN
values.doc:
An affiliate names a vault that is not an active affiliate vault of the
 broker: unknown, not yet created, disabled, another broker's, or the
 default vault. Nothing is bound to the key; create or enable the vault
 and repeat the request.

values.name: BROKER_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No broker with this name has the caller as its key or member.

values.name: ACTION_DENIED
values.doc: The caller's role, or a broker API key, may not perform the action.

values.name: STEP_UP_REQUIRED
values.doc:
The action needs a fresh step-up proof of the acting member in the
 X-Auth-Step-Up header, and none was sent or it was already used or
 expired. Complete an MFA challenge for fresh step-up and repeat the
 request with the new proof.

values.name: VAULT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The broker has no affiliate vault with this ID.

values.name: KEY_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The broker has no API key with this ID, or it no longer works.

values.name: KEY_LIMIT
values.doc: The broker would have more than two working API keys. Revoke one first.

values.name: LAST_KEY
values.doc:
The key is the broker's last key that works without an expiry; create
 another key first.

values.name: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
The person is not a member of the broker and has no pending invite, or
 the account does not exist.

values.name: ALREADY_MEMBER
values.doc: The person is already a member of the broker.

values.name: OWNER_IMMUTABLE
values.doc:
The Owner cannot be removed or given another role; transfer ownership
 instead.

values.name: INVITE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No pending invite with this ID is addressed to the caller.

values.name: FEES_INVALID
values.doc:
The fees are not valid: more than three affiliates, an affiliate without
 a valid account_id or with bps outside 1 to 300, a vault named twice, or
 broker_bps and the affiliates' bps totalling more than 300.

values.name: STATS_INCOMPLETE
values.doc:
The broker stats cannot be read: a QuickSwap in the window, named by
 ErrorDetail.swap_id, is missing a record they need. Contact Polyester
 broker support with the swap_id.

values.name: ADDRESS_CONFLICT
values.doc:
The QuickSwap (swap_id in the error) cannot be issued a deposit address
 and never gets one, so nothing can be deposited to it. Create a new
 QuickSwap with a new idempotency key, and report the swap_id to Polyester
 broker support.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to QuickSwap errors. ConnectRPC clients receive it
 as an error detail of type swap.quickswap.v1.ErrorDetail. REST clients
 receive an application/problem+json body {type, title, status, detail,
 code, swapId, minDepositAmount, maxDepositAmount} whose code is the
 ErrorCode name, or the status name (for example INVALID_ARGUMENT) when no
 ErrorCode applies; swapId and the limits appear only when set.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc:
QuickSwap bound to the request's idempotency key, when one exists: for
 example the original QuickSwap on IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, or the QuickSwap
 whose deposit address could not be allocated.

fields.name: min_deposit_amount
fields.doc:
AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE only: the smallest deposit that currently quotes on
 the route with the requested protection, in source token units, whatever
 the request's basis. It moves with prices and network fees; show it as
 guidance, not a guarantee. A deposit below QuickSwapQuote.min_deposit_amount
 is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM). Unset for other
 codes and when no deposit currently quotes.

fields.name: max_deposit_amount
fields.doc:
AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE only: the largest deposit that quotes, in source token
 units. Unset for other codes, when no deposit currently quotes, and for a
 bridge, whose deposit no order book bounds.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Execution
types.doc: Execution selects how the credited deposit is traded.

fields.name: market
fields.doc: Execute immediately.

fields.name: twap
fields.doc: Execute in equal time slices.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionProgress
types.doc: ExecutionProgress is the trading progress of a QuickSwap.

fields.name: input_amount
fields.doc: Credited amount committed to execution, in source token units.

fields.name: executed_input
fields.doc:
Source amount traded so far, in source token units. On a two-leg route
 this counts the first leg. Zero for a bridge, which trades nothing.

fields.name: output_amount
fields.doc:
Destination amount acquired so far after service, broker and affiliate
 fees and before withdrawal network fees, in destination token units. Zero for a
 bridge: its destination withdrawal pays the credit less its fees.

fields.name: intermediate_remainder
fields.doc:
On a two-leg route, intermediate asset acquired but not yet converted, in
 the refund route's token units; unset for a direct route and a bridge.

fields.name: completed_slices
fields.doc:
Completed slices: a market execution's one slice completes when
 execution finishes. Zero for a bridge.

fields.name: total_slices
fields.doc:
Planned slices: a market execution has one once it is planned. Zero
 until then, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.

fields.name: started_at
fields.doc: When execution started.

fields.name: deadline
fields.doc:
Execution deadline: started_at plus the TWAP duration, or plus the market
 execution window. Funds not converted by then are refunded or returned.
 Independent of the quote validity and the funding window. Unset until
 the execution is planned, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.doc: When execution finished; unset while executing.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.FeeKind
types.doc: FeeKind identifies one component of a QuickSwap's fees.

values.name: SERVICE
values.doc:
Service fee of one trading leg: the leg's pair fee in basis points of
 what the leg receives. A two-leg route has one per leg. On a bridge, the
 one bridge fee in basis points of the credited amount, charged at payout.

values.name: BROKER
values.doc:
Broker fee of one trading leg, the request's broker_bps of what the leg
 receives, credited to the broker's default vault. A two-leg route has one
 per leg; a bridge has one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.

values.name: AFFILIATE
values.doc:
Affiliate fee of one trading leg, one affiliate's bps of what the leg
 receives, credited to that affiliate vault. Each affiliate has one per
 leg; on a bridge one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.

values.name: DEPOSIT_NETWORK
values.doc: Network fee withheld from the deposit before it is credited.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_NETWORK

fields.name: vault_account_id

Only QuickSwaps whose fees credit this vault: an affiliate vault they
 name, or the default vault when they set a broker fee. Zero for every

fields.name: statuses

Only QuickSwaps in one of these statuses, at most 16; empty for every

fields.name: start_time

Only QuickSwaps created before end_time (exclusive); unset for no upper

MarketExecution executes the credited deposit as soon as possible, in one or

fields.doc: Public account ID of the person's own account.

fields.name: broker_display_name
fields.doc: Broker display name.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: The caller's role.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Protection
types.doc:
Protection bounds the worst execution the end user accepts. It is fixed when
 the QuickSwap is created and is enforced on every execution, however long
 after the quote the deposit arrives.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc:
Maximum shortfall from the quoted expected output in basis points
 (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 1000. Converted at creation into the quote's
 min_amount_out and min_rate.

fields.name: min_amount_out
fields.doc:
Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the quoted deposit
 amount, in destination token units. Converted at creation into the
 quote's min_rate.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwap
types.doc:
QuickSwap is one broker-owned swap of an external deposit into external
 withdrawals. The end user needs no account.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Public QuickSwap identifier.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: The broker's idempotency key that created this QuickSwap.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Why the status is notable (held, returning, delayed, terminal without
 destination output); REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise. When a payout
 completes but a refund or return was NOT_SENT, the status follows the
 paid withdrawals (for example COMPLETED) and the reason is
 REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM. A FAILED withdrawal takes precedence: the status is
 HELD and the reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc:
True when status is terminal; authoritative, including for status values
 added later. Polling can stop at a terminal status. A terminal status
 never changes. Shortly after it, address_retires_at can still move later,
 and withdrawal details can be corrected as documented on Withdrawal;
 another deposit reaching the address also shows. Read it again if the end
 user reports such a deposit or needs the final retirement time.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Accepted economic terms.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of the swap output on the destination network. Addresses and
 memos are in their network's canonical form (for example lowercase EVM
 hex), which can differ in case or encoding from the create request; that
 form is the one paid.

fields.name: destination_memo
fields.doc: Destination tag or memo for destination_address; empty when none.

fields.name: return_address
fields.doc: Recipient of returned source funds on the source network.

fields.name: return_memo
fields.doc: Destination tag or memo for return_address; empty when none.

fields.name: refund_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Refund route (asset and network) of the intermediate asset; zero when
 none was supplied.

fields.name: refund_address
fields.doc: Recipient of refunded intermediate asset; empty when none was supplied.

fields.name: refund_memo
fields.doc: Destination tag or memo for refund_address; empty when none.

fields.name: quote
fields.doc: Quote and protection fixed at creation. Not refreshed on retries.

fields.name: deposit_instructions
fields.doc: Where and until when to deposit; absent while ALLOCATING.

fields.name: screening
fields.doc: Risk screening.

fields.name: deposits
fields.doc: Detected deposits, oldest first, at most 50.

fields.name: deposits_truncated
fields.doc:
True when more than 50 deposits were detected; only the first 50 are
 listed.

fields.name: execution
fields.doc: Execution progress; absent before execution starts.

fields.name: withdrawals
fields.doc: Withdrawals, oldest first, at most 50.

fields.name: withdrawals_truncated
fields.doc: True when more than 50 withdrawals exist; only the first 50 are listed.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap last changed.

fields.name: terminal_at
fields.doc: When status became terminal; unset while not terminal.

fields.name: version
fields.doc:
Monotonic state version: a snapshot with a lower version is older. Zero
 while ALLOCATING; 1 once the deposit address is issued
 (AWAITING_DEPOSIT); every later change increments it.

fields.name: fee_schedule_version
fields.doc:
Fee schedule version fixed at creation. Every execution or bridge payout
 of this QuickSwap is charged that version's service fees, whatever later
 versions change.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc: Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation.

fields.name: charged_fees
fields.doc:
Broker and affiliate fees charged so far, as settled: one entry per fee
 kind, credited vault and asset, in kind, then account_id, then asset_id
 order. Grows while the QuickSwap executes or pays out a bridge.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapQuote
types.doc:
QuickSwapQuote is the priced view of a QuickSwap's terms. Price fields are
 estimates at quoted_at; only the protection fields are guarantees.

 The end user may deposit any amount from min_deposit_amount to
 max_deposit_amount. min_amount_out applies only to a deposit of exactly
 deposit_amount that fully converts; for any other deposit the guarantee is
 min_rate on the converted part.

 The credit is the deposit less the deposit network fee. Every amount below
 is in token units of its route.

fields.name: deposit_amount
fields.doc:
Source amount the quote was computed for, in source token units. Equals
 the request amount for SOURCE_AMOUNT; computed for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

fields.name: expected_amount_out
fields.doc:
Expected destination amount for deposit_amount at quoted_at, after
 trading fees and both quoted network fees, in destination token units. An
 estimate, not a guarantee.

fields.name: min_amount_out
fields.doc:
Guaranteed minimum delivered amount, in destination token units, at the
 quoted network fees, for a deposit of exactly deposit_amount that fully
 converts to the destination asset. For any other deposit, and for a
 deposit only partly converted, the guarantee is min_rate on the converted
 part.

fields.name: min_rate
fields.doc:
Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source
 display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits,
 rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the
 way to the destination asset, the destination output before the
 withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to
 destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted
 is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the
 second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to
 return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not
 convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those
 parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the
 output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the
 quote.

fields.name: min_deposit_amount
fields.doc:
Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the
 deposit before its network fee. A smaller deposit is returned to
 return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM). It is never below the source
 network's minimum
 (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config), and differs from
 ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently
 quotes.

fields.name: max_deposit_amount
fields.doc:
Largest deposit that is eligible to execute, in source token units,
 compared with the deposit before its network fee. Fixed when the
 QuickSwap is created. A larger deposit is returned to return_address
 (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM). Unset for a bridge, whose deposit no order book
 bounds.

fields.name: intermediate_asset_id
fields.doc:
Unified asset ID of the intermediate asset of a two-leg route (for
 example USDT for BTC to SOL): the AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. Zero for a direct route or a
 bridge. When non-zero, CreateQuickSwap requires a refund address for that
 asset. The route is fixed at creation.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc:
Quoted fee components for deposit_amount: each leg's service, broker and
 affiliate fees, in that order, legs in route order (a bridge has one set,
 charged at payout), then network fees. Affiliates are in ascending
 account_id order. Zero fees are omitted.

fields.name: quoted_at
fields.doc: When the quote was priced.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
End of the short quote validity, typically seconds to minutes after
 quoted_at. Display the quote until expires_at. CreateQuickSwap prices the
 terms again and never fails because a quote expired. After it the price
 fields are stale; the protection of a created QuickSwap still applies.
 Independent of the funding window and the execution deadline.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapReason
types.doc: QuickSwapReason explains a notable status or deposit disposition.

values.name: SOURCE_SCREENING_FAILED
values.doc:
The deposit's risk screen failed with a return verdict; the deposit is
 not accepted and is returned to return_address.

values.name: CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
The deposit arrived and is safe, but processing capacity is temporarily
 unavailable. Processing resumes automatically when capacity frees up; no
 action is needed.

values.name: PROTECTION_NOT_MET
values.doc:
Execution could not meet the protection. On a HELD QuickSwap nothing was
 traded and the funds are held for review; otherwise untraded funds are
 refunded or returned.

values.name: EXECUTION_DEADLINE_REACHED
values.doc:
The execution deadline passed before all input executed; untraded funds
 are refunded or returned. Shown while EXECUTING once the deadline ended
 trading, and on the payout statuses that follow.

values.name: LATE_DEPOSIT
values.doc: The deposit was first seen after funding_expires_at.

values.name: DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc:
The deposit is below the published min_deposit_amount. It is not
 executed: it is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows
 RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason. A deposit that cannot be returned
 on the network it was received on is held (HELD with this reason); the
 broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

values.name: DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM
values.doc:
The deposit is above max_deposit_amount; it is returned to
 return_address.

values.name: WRONG_ASSET
values.doc:
The deposit is not the quoted source asset or network. It is not
 executed: it is returned to return_address on the network and in the
 asset it was received in, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED
 with this reason. A deposit that cannot be returned there, such as one
 received on a network where return_address is not valid, is held (HELD
 with this reason); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the
 swap_id.

values.name: FUNDING_WINDOW_ENDED
values.doc: The funding window ended without an eligible deposit.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_FAILED
values.doc:
A withdrawal cannot be completed and is held for review. The broker
 contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

values.name: OUTCOME_RECONCILING
values.doc:
A processing step is being confirmed. Processing resumes automatically; no
 action is needed.

values.name: SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED
values.doc:
Polyester's deposit screening blocked the deposit. It is held for
 compliance review; it is never executed or returned automatically. The
 broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

values.name: REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc:
Refund not possible: an amount left to refund or return was below the
 withdrawal minimum of its asset and network, so no withdrawal was made
 for it. Its withdrawal is NOT_SENT with the amount in unsent_amount.
 Other withdrawals are unaffected.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapStatus
types.doc:
QuickSwapStatus is the current state of a QuickSwap. While funds progress,
 the status names the earliest gate still outstanding; gates that complete
 concurrently are not reported separately.

 Flow: ALLOCATING → AWAITING_DEPOSIT → (WAITING_FOR_CAPACITY |
 PREPARING_DEPOSIT | CONFIRMING) → CREDITED → EXECUTING (skipped for a
 bridge) → PAYING_OUT | REFUNDING | RETURNING → a terminal status. HELD can
 be entered from any non-terminal status and is not terminal. The terminal
 statuses are COMPLETED, REFUNDED, RETURNED and EXPIRED; a terminal status
 never changes. Accept status values added later; is_terminal is
 authoritative.

values.name: ALLOCATING
values.doc:
The quote is fixed and the deposit address is being allocated. After
 ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE, allocation continues automatically until an address
 frees up; the wait has no fixed bound.

values.name: AWAITING_DEPOSIT
values.doc:
Quote and deposit address allocated; waiting for the first eligible
 deposit before funding_expires_at.

values.name: WAITING_FOR_CAPACITY
values.doc:
An eligible deposit arrived and is safe; waiting for processing capacity.
 Processing resumes automatically when capacity frees up; the wait has no
 fixed bound.

values.name: PREPARING_DEPOSIT
values.doc: The deposit is being prepared for credit. Retries keep this status.

values.name: CONFIRMING
values.doc: Waiting for source confirmations and deposit validation before credit.

values.name: CREDITED
values.doc: The deposit is credited; execution is starting.

values.name: EXECUTING
values.doc: The credited deposit is being traded.

values.name: PAYING_OUT
values.doc:
Execution finished with destination output; withdrawals, including any
 partial refund or return, are in progress.

values.name: REFUNDING
values.doc:
A two-leg route produced no destination output; the intermediate asset is
 being refunded to refund_address.

values.name: RETURNING
values.doc:
Nothing was traded or the deposit was not accepted; the source funds are
 being returned to return_address.

values.name: HELD
values.doc:
Funds are held for review. Not terminal: review resumes the QuickSwap or
 returns the funds. reason says why when a specific reason applies, else
 it is REASON_UNSPECIFIED. The broker contacts Polyester broker support
 with the swap_id.

values.name: COMPLETED
values.doc:
Terminal: every withdrawal is final (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT) and at least
 one is a DESTINATION withdrawal. A DESTINATION withdrawal is never
 NOT_SENT.

values.name: REFUNDED
values.doc:
Terminal: every withdrawal is final, none is DESTINATION, and at least one
 is REFUND (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT).

values.name: RETURNED
values.doc:
Terminal: every withdrawal is final and all are RETURN (FINALIZED or
 NOT_SENT).

values.name: EXPIRED
values.doc: Terminal: the funding window ended without an eligible deposit.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapSummary
types.doc:
QuickSwapSummary is one QuickSwap in a list: its state and fees. Get it
 with QuickSwapService.GetQuickSwap for its quote, deposit and withdrawals.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Public QuickSwap identifier.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: The broker's idempotency key that created it.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why the status is notable; REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc: True when status is terminal.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Accepted economic terms.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc:
Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation; unset when
 the request set none.

fields.name: charged_fees
fields.doc: Broker and affiliate fees charged so far, as settled, as on QuickSwap.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap last changed.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapTerms
types.doc:
QuickSwapTerms are the economic terms of one QuickSwap. The same terms are
 used to quote and to create, and are echoed unchanged on the QuickSwap.
 Source and destination are either two assets, which are traded, or one asset
 on two networks, a bridge: the deposit is credited and withdrawn to the
 destination network without a trade. Any two zipped_asset_ids from the
 config may be quoted; QuoteQuickSwap is authoritative for whether the route
 is offered.

fields.name: source_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Source asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user deposits this asset on
 this network.

fields.name: destination_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Destination asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user receives this asset on
 this network.

fields.name: basis
fields.doc: Side of the swap that amount denominates.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Positive amount in the token units of the route selected by basis: source
 route for SOURCE_AMOUNT, destination route for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

fields.name: protection
fields.doc: Worst execution the end user accepts.

fields.name: execution
fields.doc:
Market or TWAP execution. A bridge trades nothing and takes market only;
 TWAP on a bridge is ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteBasis
types.doc: QuoteBasis states which side of the swap the request amount denominates.

values.name: SOURCE_AMOUNT
values.doc:
amount is the source amount the end user intends to deposit, in source
 token units.

values.name: DESTINATION_AMOUNT
values.doc:
amount is the destination amount the end user wants to receive after fees,
 in destination token units. The quote reports the deposit amount needed at
 the quoted price. The delivered amount still follows the actual deposit
 and execution, bounded below by the protection.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteFee
types.doc:
QuoteFee is one fee component of a quote. Trading fees (SERVICE, BROKER
 and AFFILIATE) are charged when each leg settles, in the asset that leg
 receives: the base asset on a buy, the quote asset on a sell. Each is
 computed on its own from what the leg receives and rounded down when
 charged. A bridge has no settlement; its fees are charged at payout, in
 the destination asset.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Fee component.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset and network the fee is charged in, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero for a
 trading fee of the first leg of a two-leg route, which is charged in the
 intermediate asset (intermediate_asset_id).

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Fee in zipped_asset_id's token units; for a fee charged in the
 intermediate asset, in the intermediate asset at its trading precision
 (amount.decimals). Trading fees are rounded up, so the charged fee never
 exceeds the quoted one.

fields.name: bps
fields.doc:
Rate of a trading fee in basis points of what the leg receives; zero for
 a network fee.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
AFFILIATE only: public sub-account ID of the affiliate vault credited
 with the fee; zero for every other kind.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteQuickSwapRequest
types.doc:
QuoteQuickSwapRequest prices terms, with the broker and affiliate fees,
 without reserving anything.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Terms to price.

fields.name: broker_bps
fields.doc:
Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of
 the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none.
 broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300. Fees outside these
 rules fail with FEES_INVALID.

fields.name: affiliates
fields.doc:
Affiliate fees, each charged on top and credited to its affiliate vault:
 at most three distinct vaults.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteQuickSwapResponse
types.doc: QuoteQuickSwapResponse is an indicative quote.

fields.name: quote
fields.doc:
Indicative quote, including whether the route needs a refund address.
 Creating a QuickSwap prices the terms again.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RemoveMemberRequest
types.doc:
RemoveMemberRequest removes a member, or cancels the person's pending
 invite.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Public account ID of the member or invited person.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RemoveMemberResponse
types.doc: RemoveMemberResponse is empty.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RequestedFees
types.doc:
RequestedFees are the broker and affiliate fees a QuickSwap request set,
 charged on top of the service fee.

fields.name: broker_bps
fields.doc:
Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, credited to the
 broker's default vault.

fields.name: affiliates
fields.doc: Affiliate fees, in ascending account_id order.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RespondToInviteRequest
types.doc:
RespondToInviteRequest accepts or declines a pending invite addressed to
 the caller.

fields.name: invite_id
fields.doc: Public invite ID.

fields.name: accept
fields.doc: True to accept, false to decline.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RespondToInviteResponse
types.doc: RespondToInviteResponse returns the caller's new membership.

fields.name: membership
fields.doc: The membership; unset when the invite was declined.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RevokeKeyRequest
types.doc: RevokeKeyRequest revokes a key immediately.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: Key to revoke.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RevokeKeyResponse
types.doc: RevokeKeyResponse returns the revoked key.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The key.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RotateKeyRequest
types.doc:
RotateKeyRequest replaces a key by a new one. The old key keeps working
 for the overlap, then stops.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name. A broker API key may name only its own broker.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: Key to rotate. A broker API key may rotate only itself.

fields.name: overlap_seconds
fields.doc:
How long the old key keeps working, in seconds, from 0 to 604800 (7
 days). Default 86400 (24 hours). 0 revokes it immediately.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RotateKeyResponse
types.doc:
RotateKeyResponse returns the new key, its token and the old key. The token
 is shown only here and cannot be recovered.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The new key.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Bearer token qsk_<key id>_<secret> of the new key.

fields.name: previous_key
fields.doc: The old key, with the end of its overlap.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Screening
types.doc:
Screening is the risk screening of a QuickSwap. Deposits are screened on
 arrival; the outcome shows in the status, its reason and each deposit's
 disposition and reason.

fields.name: source_wallet
fields.doc:
Source wallet supplied in the request; empty when none was supplied.
 Recorded and shown; not used to accept or reject a deposit.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.SetMemberRoleRequest
types.doc: SetMemberRoleRequest changes a member's role.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Public account ID of the member.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: New role; never OWNER.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.SetMemberRoleResponse
types.doc: SetMemberRoleResponse is empty.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.SetVaultStatusRequest
types.doc:
SetVaultStatusRequest enables or disables an affiliate vault for new
 QuickSwaps.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name. A broker API key may name only its own broker.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Public sub-account ID of the vault.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: New status.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.SetVaultStatusResponse
types.doc: SetVaultStatusResponse returns the vault.

fields.name: vault
fields.doc: The vault.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.StatsPeriod
types.doc: StatsPeriod is the UTC calendar period GetBrokerStats groups by.

values.name: DAY
values.doc: A UTC day.

values.name: MONTH
values.doc: A UTC month.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.StatusCount
types.doc: StatusCount is how many QuickSwaps are in one status.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: The status.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: QuickSwaps in it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.TokenAmount
types.doc: TokenAmount is an exact token amount in the token's smallest unit.

fields.name: base_units
fields.doc:
Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example
 satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or
 leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

fields.name: decimals
fields.doc:
Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in
 requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the
 token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the
 asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the
 destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for
 Protection.min_amount_out.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.TransferOwnershipRequest
types.doc: TransferOwnershipRequest makes another member the Owner.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc: Public account ID of the member who becomes the Owner.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.TransferOwnershipResponse
types.doc: TransferOwnershipResponse is empty.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.TwapExecution
types.doc: TwapExecution spreads execution evenly over a duration.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.doc:
Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to
 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when
 the QuickSwap is created.

fields.name: slice_interval_ms
fields.doc:
Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to
 duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded
 up.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.VaultStatus
types.doc: VaultStatus says whether an affiliate vault can be named by new QuickSwaps.

values.name: VAULT_ACTIVE
values.doc: New QuickSwaps can credit the vault.

values.name: VAULT_DISABLED
values.doc:
New QuickSwaps naming the vault are refused with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN.
 QuickSwaps already created still credit it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Withdrawal
types.doc:
Withdrawal is one outgoing payment. A QuickSwap can end with several, for
 example a partial refund plus the destination payout; the best case is a
 single destination withdrawal.

fields.name: index
fields.doc:
Zero-based position in the withdrawals list. Not stable: a withdrawal's
 position can change between reads, so do not use it as an identifier.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Why this withdrawal pays its recipient.

fields.name: deposit_index
fields.doc: Deposit whose funds this withdrawal moves.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset and network paid, as a zipped_asset_id.

fields.name: address
fields.doc: Recipient address in the network's native text form.

fields.name: memo
fields.doc: Recipient destination tag or memo; empty when the network uses none.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Amount delivered to address after the network fee, in zipped_asset_id's
 token units; set once FINALIZED. Like tx_hash, it is the amount recorded
 for this withdrawal and can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the
 QuickSwap ends (terminal_at).

fields.name: network_fee
fields.doc:
Actual network fee withheld from this withdrawal, in the same units; set
 once FINALIZED. Can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap
 ends, like amount.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Withdrawal progress.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc:
Recipient-network transaction recorded for this withdrawal; empty until
 the transaction is committed on the recipient network. It can be
 corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends (terminal_at) and is
 not updated after that. For the authoritative, latest state of the
 transfer, read flow_id.

fields.name: submitted_at
fields.doc: When the withdrawal was submitted; unset until submitted.

fields.name: finalized_at
fields.doc: When the withdrawal became final; unset until FINALIZED.

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc:
Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this withdrawal, usable with
 GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. The flow is
 the authoritative, latest state of the transfer, including a correction
 made after tx_hash, amount and network_fee stop being updated. Lifecycle
 flow amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base
 units.

fields.name: unsent_amount
fields.doc:
Set only when state is NOT_SENT: the amount for which no withdrawal was
 made because it was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and
 network. In zipped_asset_id's token units, rounded down to the token's
 smallest unit.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.WithdrawalRole
types.doc: WithdrawalRole is why a withdrawal pays its recipient.

values.name: DESTINATION
values.doc: Swap output to destination_address on the destination network.

values.name: REFUND
values.doc:
Untraded intermediate asset of a two-leg route, including a partial
 refund, to refund_address on the refund route's network.

values.name: RETURN
values.doc:
Source funds that were not accepted or not traded, to return_address on
 the network and in the asset they were received in: the source network,
 or for a wrong asset the network it was sent on.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.WithdrawalState
types.doc:
WithdrawalState is the progress of one withdrawal. FINALIZED and NOT_SENT
 are final: they never change. A FAILED withdrawal never changes either, but
 it does not end the QuickSwap: while any withdrawal is FAILED, the
 QuickSwap is HELD with reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED and the funds stay
 attributed to it until support resolves it.

values.name: QUEUED
values.doc: Approved and waiting to be submitted.

values.name: SUBMITTED
values.doc: Submitted to the recipient's network; not yet final.

values.name: FINALIZED
values.doc: Final on the recipient's network.

values.name: FAILED
values.doc:
Definitively failed. The QuickSwap is HELD (WITHDRAWAL_FAILED); the
 broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

values.name: NOT_SENT
values.doc:
Final: no transaction was or will be made for this withdrawal, because
 its amount was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network
 (REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM); unsent_amount is that amount.
